description: Throughput, numerically near-equivalent. Batch Newton-Schulz across conv weights by grouping same-shape weights into one batched matmul call. Use torch._foreach ops for the SGD updates on biases, BN and the head. Capture the full train step (forward, backward, Muon, SGD) in a CUDA graph with static input buffers, and warm it up in build on synthetic data. Pass the LR schedule as a GPU tensor so per-step LR changes need no recapture. prepare resets all parameter and state tensors in place.
